entries.name: Straight road
entries.description: Straight alignment; baseline geometry for corridor rendering.

entries.name: Sharp left curve
entries.description: Tight left-hand curve that may require speed reduction.

entries.name: Sharp right curve
entries.description: Tight right-hand curve that may require speed reduction.

entries.name: Hairpin bend
entries.description: Near-180° bend typical of ghat roads.

entries.name: S-bend
entries.description: Reverse curves in quick succession.

entries.name: U-turn
entries.description: Median opening or location where vehicles make U-turns across traffic.

entries.name: T-junction
entries.description: Three-arm junction where the road ends at a crossing road.

entries.name: Y-junction
entries.description: Fork where the road splits into two branches.

entries.name: Four-way junction
entries.description: Four-arm at-grade intersection.

entries.name: Roundabout
entries.description: Circulatory junction.

entries.name: Road narrowing
entries.description: Carriageway width reduces.

entries.name: Lane merging
entries.description: Two lanes merge into one.

entries.name: Lane splitting
entries.description: One lane divides into two; lane choice required.

entries.name: Flyover
entries.description: Grade-separated elevated road section.

entries.name: Underpass
entries.description: Road passing below another road or railway.

entries.name: Interchange
entries.description: Grade-separated junction with connecting ramps.

entries.name: Bridge
entries.description: Road carried over water or a valley.

entries.name: Tunnel
entries.description: Enclosed road section with changed lighting and escape constraints.

entries.name: Steep uphill
entries.description: Steep ascent; heavy vehicles may slow sharply.

entries.name: Steep downhill
entries.description: Steep descent; brake fade and long stopping distances.

entries.name: Blind crest
entries.description: Summit that hides the road and traffic beyond it.

entries.name: Road dip
entries.description: Sag in the road profile that can hide vehicles or hold water.

entries.name: Railway crossing
entries.description: At-grade crossing with a railway line.

entries.name: Missing shoulder
entries.description: No paved or usable shoulder beside the carriageway.

entries.name: Road-edge drop
entries.description: Vertical drop between carriageway edge and shoulder.
